items.caption: This seal-style form of 乍 illustrates the phonetic component identified in the received analysis of 昨.
items.alt: Black seal-style strokes forming 乍 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It clearly depicts the named phonetic component, helping explain the received structural analysis; it is a modern redraw, not evidence of 昨’s own graphic history.

limitations.text: The available image illustrates 乍 rather than 昨. The cited account supports 昨’s 日-plus-乍 analysis and records seal and Warring States manuscript forms, but does not establish earlier graphic development or the date of its earliest use.
